main_text.p: ¶ Deo interdum tribuitur, quod creaturæ, aut homini proprium est: cum Deo tribuuntur Alæ, (hoc est, protectio, seu defensio) Deut.32.10. Psal.17.8.& 57.1. Aures ( id est, affabilitas, et facilitas in exaudiendo) Psal.34.3.& 34.16. Brachium ( hoc est, robur, potentia & fortitudo) Genesis 29.24. Exod.6.6. Deut.4.34.1 Sam.2.31 1.Regum 8.42.2. Reg.17.36.2. Para.6. 2. Luc.1 51.&c. Vide BRACHIVM.

Caput,1.Cor.11.3. Vide Deus Caput Christi. Digitus (id est, virtus) Exodi 8.19. (& artificium) Exod. 31.18. Facies quæ nunc præsentiam, nunc favorem & benignitatem Dei significat) Psalm.27.v.8.9.& 31.17. & 89.15. Furor ( hoc est horrendum Dei iudicium, & pœna ab irato Deo infli-ta) Psalm.6.1.& 59.14. Manus (id est, potentia, protectio, liberatas, artificium, & quæ his confinia sunt) Iob 19.21.& 28.8. Psal.31.6.& 8.7.& 91.12.& 145.16. Hebr.2.6. Nares, qui-bus odoratus dicitur (id est, acceptatio, qua sacrificia grata et accepta habet) Gen.8.21. Nasus ( id est, furor accensus,) Jer.39.37.

[Oculi, i.beneuolentia & fauor in electos : Deut.32.10.1. Reg.8.v.29.52.2 Par.6.v.20.40.& 7.15. Nehem.1.6. Iob 10. Psal.17.2.& 33.18,& 34.16. Prou.15.3. Esai.49.16. Zach.12. 1.Petr.3.12. Indignatio & ira in impios,2.Sam.22.28.Esa. 8.& 65.12.& 66.4. Ezech.4.v.7.9.& 5.11.& 8.13.& 9.10. Amos 9.v.4.8. Providentia Divina,2.Par.16 9.Psalm.14.2.& 4.2.& 66 7.& 90.4.& 139 16.Ier.5 3. Zach.4.10.Heb.4.13. iustitia.Habac.1.13.]

Pedes,hoc est, robur vel potestas,Psal 18.7. & 110.1.Matt. 2.44. Actor.2.v.34.35.1.Corinth.15.v.25.27.Hebr.1.13.& 10. 3. vide Esai.66.1. Matth.5.35. Actor.7.48. Pupilla id quod est carissimum Deut.32.10. Psalm.17.8.Zach.2 8. Vultus, hoc est, ira, Psal.34.17.

Hanc figurâ Scripturæ familiarem, qua membra humana & humanæ passiones ac effectus Deo tribuuntur, vocant Antropopathian: de quo dicendi genere notetur regula: Membra corporea & humanæ passiones, seu affectus Deo tributa semper incorporaliter significât, & vt plurimum
